title: Canonicalize Target Graphql Operation Fields
description: Clean semio/graphql/target.schema.graphql operation field names so operation API names are action-first, e.g. createdDesign instead of designCreated.
summary: Removed implicit design/type context suffixes from semio/graphql/target.schema.graphql operation API names, preserving explicit disambiguators like changePieceToType and attribute owner names. Restored the valid KitChange mutation payload shape and removed undefined artifact/document subscription references so the SDL builds.
